# EMF GenModel Generator

> Eclipse/Tycho-based code generator that produces Builder pattern classes and Helper utilities from EMF GenModel files, distributed as Eclipse plugins via P2 update sites.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Xtend 2.39.0 / Xtext 2.39.0 for template-based code generation
- Maven 3.9.4+ with Tycho 4.0.13 (Eclipse plugin build tooling), 6 modules
- Generates fluent Builder classes and stream-based ModelResourceSupport helpers from EMF GenModels
- Integrates into MWE2 workflows used by downstream JUDO metamodel projects
- Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview with architecture diagrams
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Comprehensive developer guide with build commands, architecture, template development, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and contribution guidelines
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): CI/CD pipeline and branching documentation

## Modules

- [core/](core/): Base generation engine with Guice DI, validation framework, and abstract base classes
- [builder/](builder/): Builder pattern code generator producing fluent builders per concrete EClass
- [helper/](helper/): Helper code generator producing stream-based ModelResourceSupport classes
- [ecore/](ecore/): Self-hosted module that generates builders and helpers for the Ecore metamodel itself
- [feature/](feature/): Eclipse feature packaging bundling all plugins
- [site/](site/): Eclipse P2 update site for distribution

## Used by

- [judo-meta-asm](../../models/judo-meta-asm): ASM metamodel — Ecore-based architecture model with builders and validation
- [judo-tatami-core](../../runtime/judo-tatami-core): EMF transformation trace tracking and composable workflow engine
